title: Serberus — Log retention
description: How long serberusd keeps its on-disk decision logs. This is the only setting in this domain; it is delivered to the com.herojoneslabs.serberus.notify preference domain, which keeps its original name.

logRetentionDays.title: Log retention (days)
logRetentionDays.description: How long on-disk JSONL logs are kept before rotation cleanup.
